# What each to-be mechanism hardens (one specification per mechanism)

The to-be is the current Librarian made reliable, not a second system beside it. Owner, 26 November: the packs map the system as it is and what makes it unreliable; the build is an optimisation and hardening pass that builds on the existing code. So each to-be mechanism has one specification, and it is the existing module it extends. Where the to-be names something that already exists under another name (the agenda, the grant, the exit gates, the verifiers), this table is where the two are flattened into one. Code read at d9435e1; src/ is unchanged since. Proposed and unaccepted.

## Mechanisms and the code they build on

| To-be mechanism | Builds on, today | What the hardening changes | Where in the to-be |
|---|---|---|---|
| The Owner's agenda (UC9) | agenda.py and the `agenda` tool (dated tasks; since 8489387 also read work awaiting acceptance); checkpoints.py (typed, scope-digested decisions, resolved once) | one agenda, not two. The `agenda` tool also lists pending checkpoints and open tickets. The closed list of 13 checkpoint types gains high-risk holds, folder sensitivity and ticket escalation. The checkpoint file gets a lock, since parallel runs will write to it | `agenda:decide` |
| Tickets for failures and misalignments | the batch's partial, paused and escalated outcomes; queue_retry; checkpoints for decisions | a ticket record per failure (class, owner, evidence, repair history, re-check, review date) in the Core's store beside the checkpoints. It is not a bit mask (policy, fault register) | `doctor:runremedy` |
| The commission and the permission envelope | workflow_grant (app.start_action, granted_actions()); the Broker's allow_session; read_access's deep_read exemption | the same grant, computed from a manifest, for agent-run sessions and pipelines. ALWAYS_ASK tools and reserved decisions stay outside it | `activation-overseer:commission`, `compose:oracle_scope` |
| Stage contracts | standard/phases.yaml and phases.py (session phases, tool bundles, exit-gate checks); batch.py's STAGE_TOOLS, MODEL_STAGES and FOLDER_STAGES | the batch's and folder review's stages declared as the phases are. Refusals are reported only, in the test vault, before the Broker enforces them | `source-reading:read` |
| The Oracle's deterministic checks (Tier A) | closure.VERIFIERS and closure_audit.py (the audited session); the phases' exit-gate checks | typed obligations per stage. A verifier is reused only where its subject matches. A missing or stale check fails closed | `oracle:tiera` |
| Oracle and repair routes | role_routes.ROLES (lead, scribe, clerk, research_helper and the media roles), profiles and qualification records; GLM-5.3 qualified as Resource-Library's Clerk | an oracle slot and a repair slot of their own, with their own qualification. A run is refused when its worker and oracle resolve to the same model | `oracle:droute` |
| Folder review for agents | folder_review.FolderReview behind the /api/folders/* routes; folder_sources.queue | registered actions over the same FolderReview, usable on every folder a person has connected or routed an agent to | `folder-review:folderscreen` |
| A run's result reaches the person | the action_done event, run_status and batch_status | the result is kept and shown; the Web UI stops dropping it (app.js:8472) | `activation-web-ui:uinotify` |
| Remedies and the repertoire | standard/workflows (YAML), save_workflow, validate_workflow | remedies are workflows; promotion into the repertoire pins the digest | `catalogue:x3` |
| Claim review | the review route inside the Core (8489387); the Clerk's closed verdicts | each verdict recorded as a rebuttable claim and re-checked | `verify-claims:review` |
| Delegation | delegate and dispatch_plan, capped by the effort settings | a long plan runs in waves within the cap instead of being refused | `delegate:cite` |
| The research budget | session.budget_left, which halves a phase's budget on each return | the budget comes from the brief's manifest | `research:rounds` |
| The ingestion parent | intake_run, queue_source, process_approved and the folder routes, ordered by tier 0 by hand | one pipeline over those same actions, owned by a parent that starts each child | `ingestion:holdunmet` |
| Publication's receipt | geo_service's paper import, which reads no receipt field | the receipt's fields are read and stored, the link to the Source note included | `paper-publication:publish` |
